title: Real-TLE zero-burn baseline validation

dataset_provenance.note: The selected event itself is valid. The overall stored 120-object screening job was partial for invalid assessments; it is used here only as an offline source of exact TLE and event provenance. No network request was made.

screening_configuration.screening_method: SGP4 TEME trajectory screening with bounded golden-section TCA refinement
screening_configuration.time_scale: UTC calendar input converted to split Julian date for SGP4; no TEME frame transform

physical_event.event_identity_note: The current replay computes an event ID from the TLE-pair identity, microsecond UTC TCA, and method version. Its sub-millisecond TCA difference from the stored event therefore yields a different event ID. Both results use the same two recorded TLE element lines; the source does not establish why the historical serialized result differs at this precision.

maneuver_zero_burn.simulator: Earth two-body point-mass RK4, mu=398600.4418 km^3/s^2; 5 s integration and closest-approach grid; convergence checked at 2.5 s
maneuver_zero_burn.tca_state_frame_and_units: TEME; position km; velocity km/s; TCA and burn epochs UTC

comparison_differences.note: Differences are computed from the optimizer's zero-burn state and the replayed SGP4 event at the event TCA. Values at this magnitude reflect floating-point/numerical reconstruction for this fixture and should not be read as evidence that the propagation models are generally equivalent.

interpretation.result: The earlier approximately 0.1846 km and 781 s mismatch did not recur for this TLE-derived encounter. The former fixture assigned a one-kilometre separation and identical state velocities by hand and had provenance method=fixture; it was not a conjunction event produced by SGP4 screening.
verified_findings: The saved event contains a genuine, source-attributed pair of CelesTrak TLE records and an SGP4-derived physical event.
The current project screening code replayed the two records into one valid close approach under the archived fixed configuration.
For this encounter, zero-burn two-body closest approach is at the same sampled TCA and has a miss-distance difference at floating-point scale.
The output remains available_with_warning because the existing baseline thresholds are diagnostic and scientifically unvalidated.
interpretation.root_cause_assessment: The large prior values were specific to the artificial state fixture and are not representative of this TLE-derived encounter. Different force models remain a real methodological difference, but this pair does not establish their typical effect. The 0.000579 s discrepancy between the stored historical event and current SGP4 replay is unresolved and too small to explain or validate the prior large fixture result.

constraint_incident.details: An initial offline call to screen_tle_records was made without patching its downstream AI assessment hooks. The screening function invokes predict_from_physics and predict_orbital_anomaly once for the single event. This was unintended and violated the no-model-inference constraint. No later screening call used those hooks unpatched; the successful replay regression patched both functions to unavailable results.
constraint_incident.follow_up_action: Disclose this execution deviation; no further inference or live job was run.

tests.warning: StarletteDeprecationWarning: starlette.testclient currently uses httpx; no package was installed.

key_numerical_cross_checks: Recomputed the archived screening-export SHA-256 and matched the recorded value.
Matched both TLE lines, line-pair hashes, raw-record hashes, and raw-response hashes against the stored event provenance.
Replayed the physical event with the recorded two TLEs and fixed screening configuration while AI assessment hooks were stubbed; event ID, TCA, and miss distance matched the report.
Re-ran zero-burn optimization on the replayed event and matched the reported TCA, miss distance, and baseline miss-distance delta.

limitations: One TLE pair and one encounter do not validate general equivalence between SGP4/SDP4 and the two-body simulator.
TLEs are a historical captured sample from the repository export, not current operational data.
The source screening job was partial overall, although this pair's event and both tracks were valid.
No covariance/HBR-backed before/after Foster Pc was calculated; no collision-probability reduction or operational maneuver safety conclusion follows.
Existing baseline comparison tolerances remain unvalidated diagnostics.
